items.title: Southern Company’s $100 Billion Spending Plan Puts Its Dividend Growth to the Test
items.summary: Southern Company has hiked its payout 25 years running, yet a capital plan nearing a staggering sum is forcing it to borrow, issue shares, and freeze base rates. Can the streak survive a data center building boom?

items.title: Invest $125,000 in These 4 Utility Stocks to Collect Passive Income in Retirement
items.summary: Retirement flips the portfolio question from how big it can grow to how much cash it can send you without forcing a sale. Four regulated utilities offer one answer, but each carries a risk that could test the payout.

items.title: Entergy And 2 More Nuclear Power Stocks To Watch
items.summary: Fresh momentum for nuclear power is coming from policy, not hype. The US Senate just passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, which aims to speed up permits and modernize transmission lines for energy projects. Faster approvals can help large, low carbon power sources compete for grid space and capital. This article walks through three nuclear focused stocks from our screener that tap directly into that theme. The three stocks highlighted here offer a compelling starting...

items.title: Meet Wall Street’s Safe Passive Income Dividend Stocks: 4 Companies That Keep Paying Through Downturns
items.summary: When recessions hit, some companies keep raising the check anyway. Three consumer giants and one regulated utility did it through 2008 and 2020, yet each carries a hidden risk that could change how safe your income really is.

items.title: How Retirees Can Turn $500,000 Into Passive Income With These 5 Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Retirees need their portfolios to send home cash without selling into a downturn. One mix of five dividend payers across utilities, energy, real estate, consumer staples and telecom aims to do it, and each carries a risk worth knowing before you buy.
